Both Parabricks DeepVariant and HaplotypeCaller are experimental additions to the pipeline.

claims.text: Sarek's Sentieon BWA mem is part of a proprietary software package (Sentieon DNAseq).
In Sarek, alignment files are not published by default.
Adding --save_mapped saves the sorted CRAM and its index under {outdir}/preprocessing/mapped/<sample>/.
Adding --save_output_as_bam together with --save_mapped saves BAM instead.
In raredisease with Sentieon Dedup, alignment files are published as BAM by default.
--save_all_mapped_as_cram publishes the full alignment as CRAM; --save_noalt_mapped_as_cram publishes the alt-filtered CRAM and requires --exclude_alt.

note: All claims match context; both pipelines correctly covered.

claims.text: Use bcftools norm with the -g (--gff-annot) option and a GFF file.
When a GFF file is given, bcftools follows the HGVS 3' rule and right-aligns variants in transcripts on the forward strand.
For overlapping transcripts, the default is to left-align the variant.
Use the -R (--regions-file) option with a tab-delimited file.
The file can list positions (CHROM, POS) or intervals (CHROM, BEG, END), but not both.
Positions in the tab-delimited file are 1-based and inclusive.
A file with .bed or .bed.gz suffix is read as BED with 0-based, half-open coordinates.
The option requires indexed VCF/BCF files and cannot be combined with -r.
The whole-genome and chromosome Y QC files are intervals_wgs and intervals_y.
They are Picard-style interval list files covering the entire genome or only chromosome Y.
They are mandatory for the QC stats step.
Versions for GRCh37 and GRCh38 are supplied in the pipeline assets.
These files are not needed when using Sentieon.

note: Accurate; second sub-question correctly declared not covered.

claims.text: Base quality score recalibration should be turned off when reads are UMI tagged or when DragMap is used as mapper.
BQSR is not needed for every tool combination in Sarek.
The Control-FREEC beta allele frequency file is <tumorsample>_BAF.txt for tumor-only and <tumorsample_vs_normalsample>.mpileup.gz_BAF.txt for tumor/normal pairs.
The BAF text file contains beta allele frequencies for each possibly heterozygous SNP position.

note: Both parts supported; tumor-only mapping slight inference but matches listing.

claims.text: Sequencing QC and trimming use FastQC and fastp.
Trimming is enabled by --trim_fastq.
The citation list gives papers for individual tools only.

DeepVariant is a deep learning-based variant caller that takes aligned reads, produces pileup image tensors, classifies each with a convolutional neural network, and reports results in a standard VCF or gVCF.
DeepVariant calls are joint genotyped with GLnexus and then normalized with bcftools norm.
By default only the normalized VCF files are placed in the output folder.
In a separate mitochondrial analysis, mitochondrial calls are filtered from the normalized VCFs with GATK SelectVariants before publishing.
In Sarek, DeepVariant results for normal samples are written to {outdir}/variant_calling/deepvariant/<sample>/ as VCF and gVCF with tabix indexes.

note: Supported; GLnexus step is raredisease-specific but answer does not label pipeline.

claims.text: The SPARQL store is pyoxigraph, a local, persistent store.
It has named graphs tbox, abox, inferred and links, and queries run over the union of these graphs.
Time was measured as the median of 5 runs on a local machine.
The data set is small, so absolute numbers say little.
